summary: テスト作成前に仕様矛盾を人間が裁定し、テストは複数の有効解を受け入れる仕様レベルの振る舞い(outcome)で書き、overly strict/underspecifiedなテストを定期監査してspec versionと紐付ける

evidence.summary: OpenAI: SWE-bench Verified難問138件の59.4%にテストまたは問題記述の実質的欠陥(overly strict test, underspecified prompt)。
OpenAI: SWE-Bench Proの約30%(pipeline 27.4%, 人手34.1%)がbroken。overly strict testが正しい実装を拒否、underspecified promptが隠しtestの要求を含む。5名のengineerによる独立review。
Anthropic: 特定手順を強制するgraderは「too rigid」で有効な別解を落とす。「grade what the agent produced, not the path it took」。
prompt・test・referenceを複数有効解で監査(evidence-supported, 確度high)。
Spec-Driven Development論文: 仕様を主要artifactとし、spec-first/spec-anchored/spec-as-sourceの3段階を提示(概念整理、効果測定なし)。

obra/superpowers@brainstorming (public, reputation established): read skills/brainstorming/SKILL.md at HEAD: a HARD-GATE forbids invoking any implementation skill (TDD included) before the human partner approves; the architectural path ends in a Spec Self-Review that scans for internal contradictions ('Do any sections contradict each other?') and ambiguity ('Could any requirement be interpreted two different ways? If so, pick one and make it explicit'), and then a User Review Gate that commits the spec and waits — 'Only proceed once the user approves' — before writing-plans and the test cycle begin.

applies_when: 設計書とテストが別々に存在し矛盾し得る
AIが仕様書からテストを生成する
仕様変更が頻繁で旧テストが残る
not_applicable_when: 正解が一意で仕様が安定している純粋なbug fix

expected_effect.primary: 正しい別解の拒否と仕様外要求の混入を減らし、旧仕様テストの陳腐化を追跡可能にする
metrics: false reject率(正しい実装をテストが落とした件数)
spec versionと紐付かないテスト比率

risks: 仕様を厳密化しすぎると変更速度が落ちる
spec version紐付けは運用が形骸化しやすい
cost: 低〜中: 裁定record(docs/ or ADR)とテストのtag/命名規約
known_failure_modes: AIに矛盾する設計書をそのまま渡してテスト生成させる(正解が一意に決まらない)
実装のcall順序やprivate構造をassertする(別解拒否, Anthropic)
古いテストをskipで放置する(F21がF08の経路になる)

If so, pick one and make it explicit'), and then a User Review Gate that commits the spec and waits — 'Only proceed once the user approves' — before writing-plans and the test cycle begin.
matched_on: spec contradictions and ambiguities are resolved before any test or implementation exists
a human is the arbiter: an explicit approval gate on the written spec, not an agent's own ruling
the arbitrated spec is committed, giving tests a versioned artifact to be written against

alternates.why_not_primary: Previous primary, demoted on reputation (54-star repo, company-backed but small). It remains the only asset with the verdict ladder this remedy wants — implementation-wrong / conformance-tests-incorrect (the overly strict test) / requirements-truly-conflict, decided before anything is edited — but it is bound to the ***plain toolchain.

evidence: https://github.com/codeplain-ai/plain-forge (54 stars, 2 forks, last commit 2026-08-07, npm releases)

alternates.why_not_primary: Established and covers the remedy's second part — tests written at agreed public seams against behavior, with implementation-coupled tests named as an anti-pattern, so multiple valid implementations pass — but it does not arbitrate spec contradictions.

evidence: https://www.skills.sh/mattpocock/skills/tdd (686 installs — the highest install count seen in this batch; first seen Feb 10 2026; Trust Hub Pass, Socket Pass, Snyk Pass)

alternates.why_not_primary: Its Spec axis quotes the spec line for each finding and catches unasked-for behavior, but it reviews after the fact rather than arbitrating contradictions before tests exist.
